long_biography.plain_text:
Before moving into company communications, Keli Snyder built a broadcast portfolio around action sports. She hosted coverage of the Lucas Oil Women's Motocross Championship and worked from the pits at Monster Jam and Lucas Oil off-road races. Cycle News placed her trackside during the 2009 championship, while her USC work included producing a film about women racing Trophy Karts.

Her shift to Traxxas kept that specialist knowledge at the centre of her work. By 2012 she was appearing as the company's spokesperson and representing the TORC off-road series on air. The role joined product communication with live-event presentation, turning reporting experience into a long-running public-facing connection between a radio-control manufacturer and full-scale motorsport.

Before moving into company communications, Keli Snyder built a broadcast portfolio around action sports. Her shift to Traxxas kept that specialist knowledge at the centre of her work. By 2012 she was appearing as the company's spokesperson and representing the TORC off-road series on air. The role joined product communication with live-event presentation, turning reporting experience into a long-running public-facing connection between a radio-control manufacturer and full-scale motorsport.
